steps.what: Adjust apertures, shutter speeds, and camera focus
Adjust focus according to a combination of factors
Judge lighting, field depth, subject motion, and film speed

tasks.design: The photographer adjusts apertures, shutter speeds, and camera focus according to factors such as lighting, field depth, subject motion, film type, and film speed. The settings stay at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} chooses them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer sets the camera for the scene.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored table chooses the exposure.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing aperture, shutter, and focus stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer changes a setting the scene does not support.
tasks.altitude: The camera settings stay at full effort. Nothing in them is shortened.

evidence.claim: Setting aperture, shutter, and focus for a scene stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a scene and ends when the photographer has set the camera, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero. Film type and film speed are read by the photographer, not invented.
A later caption is a different task.
unknowns: Which scenes are reshot when the first setting fails.
research_questions: How often did the photographer change the setting after the first frame?

already_counted.description: Adjusting aperture, shutter, and focus is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the setting adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every scene is still set by the photographer. High: the same camera work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create light with flashes and reflectors
tasks.design: The photographer creates artificial light, using flashes and reflectors. The lighting stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} places a light.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer places the flashes and the reflectors.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the light stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer moves a light that does not serve the picture.
tasks.altitude: The lighting stays at full effort.

reach.task: Say what the light should do

evidence.claim: Creating artificial light with flashes and reflectors stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a scene and ends when the photographer has lit it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Taking the picture is a different task.
unknowns: Which jobs use flash, and which use only reflectors.
research_questions: How often did the photographer rebuild the light?

already_counted.description: Creating light with flashes is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the lighting adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every light is still placed by the photographer. High: the same lighting remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine desired images and picture composition
Keep selecting and adjusting subjects and equipment
Adjust lighting to achieve the desired effects

tasks.design: The photographer determines desired images and picture composition, selecting and adjusting subjects, equipment, and lighting to achieve desired effects. The choice stays at full effort. Nothing in {DOCS} composes the picture.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer chooses the composition on the set.
tasks.enabler_now: No template chooses the subject or the effect.
tasks.still_hard: Composition, subject, and effect stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer drops a composition the assignment does not support.
tasks.altitude: The composition stays at full effort. Nothing in it is shortened.

evidence.claim: Choosing composition, subjects, and lighting stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with an assignment and ends when the photographer has chosen the picture, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Shooting the chosen picture is a different task.
research_questions: Which compositions did the photographer drop?

already_counted.description: Determining the composition is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the choice adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every composition is still chosen by the photographer. High: the same choice remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Transfer photographs for editing and archive

steps.what: Choose photographs for editing, archiving, or transmission
Transfer those photographs to computers for electronic editing

tasks.design: The photographer transfers photographs to computers for editing, archiving, and electronic transmission. Choosing and transferring stay at full effort. {DOCS} does not choose the frames. Nothing is published here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer chooses the frames and copies them.
tasks.enabler_now: No rule chooses which frames move.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what is transferred stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not transfer a frame they have not chosen.
tasks.altitude: The transfer stays at full effort. Nothing is published.

reach.task: Say which pictures they expect to see
reach.learn: Which frames the photographer held back.

evidence.claim: Choosing and transferring photographs stays manual. Nothing is published in this step.

assumptions: The work starts with a card of photographs and ends when the photographer has transferred the chosen frames, or stops.
No new record is required beyond the files themselves. Upkeep is zero. Nothing is published.
Editing or captioning the files is a different task.
unknowns: Which frames are held back from transfer.
research_questions: How often did the photographer hold a frame back?

already_counted.description: Choosing the photographs is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the transfer adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every transfer is still done by the photographer. High: the same transfer remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
